# VortexML

> VortexML is a free, browser-based platform for building, training and using neural networks on tabular data. You upload a table, choose what to predict, let an AI co-pilot design the network, watch it train live, and then ask the trained model questions. An AI tutor explains every setting along the way. No installation and no code.

Things worth knowing before you browse:

- The site is a single-page application: pages are drawn by JavaScript, so a plain HTTP fetch of a page returns only a shell. This file and [llms-full.txt](https://vortexml.ro/llms-full.txt) carry the content as plain text.
- Training runs on the server (a shared Mac mini, the free tier, one run at a time with a queue), not in the browser. A run keeps going if the tab is closed.
- Trying the demo needs no account. The AI features (tutor, co-pilot, Explain Results, Assistant, Chat), saved models and the Predict page need a free account.
- VortexML won 1st place at the Scientific Communication Session 2026, Politehnica University of Bucharest.

## Start here

- [Home](https://vortexml.ro/): what the product is, a recorded walkthrough, and the full tutorial
- [Tutorial](https://vortexml.ro/tutorial): train a first model in about ten minutes, step by step, with a practice dataset and a test prompt
- [Live demo](https://vortexml.ro/demo): train a real model on a bundled dataset in one click, no account needed
- [Full text for language models](https://vortexml.ro/llms-full.txt): everything on this list, expanded

## The workflow

- [Dataset](https://vortexml.ro/dataset): upload a CSV, TSV, Excel, JSON or Parquet file (up to 100 MB), preview it, mark feature columns and the target column
- [Architect](https://vortexml.ro/architect): choose one of ten network types, set layers and hyperparameters, or let AI Auto-Configure do it from a plain-language description
- [Training](https://vortexml.ro/training): start or queue a run, watch loss and accuracy live, get an AI explanation of the result
- [Predict](https://vortexml.ro/predict): enter new values, or upload a file, and get predictions from a saved model

## AI features

- [Assistant](https://vortexml.ro/assistant): upload documents into a knowledge base and ask questions; answers cite the passages they came from
- [Chat](https://vortexml.ro/chat): a saved, streaming conversation with a language model, optionally grounded in a knowledge base

## Learn

- [Learn](https://vortexml.ro/learn): a roadmap of eight milestones, from mathematics to deployment
- [Courses](https://vortexml.ro/courses): eight written lessons on neural network architectures
- [Leaderboard](https://vortexml.ro/leaderboard): compare your own training runs side by side

## Public data (JSON, no sign-in)

- [Demo datasets](https://vortexml.ro/api/demo/datasets): the four bundled datasets, with columns, sources and a preview
- [Course list](https://vortexml.ro/api/courses): ids, titles and descriptions; one course in full at `/api/courses/{id}`
